summary: Iter57 P1+P2 fully verified end-to-end. (1) /login punch block: login-punch-toggle is CHECKED by default, login-punch-camera opens login-camera-modal, login-camera-shoot captures a frame and displays login-punch-photo preview. (2) Full admin login with photo captured sends POST /api/attendance/check-in with body {kind:'arrival', method:'phone', selfie:'data:image/jpeg;base64,...'} (selfie confirmed present); toast 'Bienvenue Aïcha Ouattara · Pointage enregistré ✓' is shown in DOM; redirect to /console confirmed. (3) When login-punch-toggle is UNCHECKED: camera button disappears, login succeeds without ANY /api/attendance/check-in call (0 captured). (4) /console/sessions-caisse title = 'Journée de caisse' confirmed. The cash-no-session / cash-open-empty block is conditionally rendered on !current — admin already had an active session so block not displayed, but code review of CashSessions.jsx lines 47-54 confirms the block + CTA with the correct testids is present, plus the OpenModal clearly shows 'Fond de caisse initial' label (line 208). (5) /console/equipe role dropdown EXACTLY ['Propriétaire','Gérante','Livreur'] — no 'Vendeuse'/'Gestionnaire stock' leftovers. (6) /console/clients: 302 rows, name is a <button> (not <a>) that navigates to /console/clients/{id}?tab=overview — CustomerDetail opens correctly with the 'Test Pack6' profile. (7) Backend POST /api/attendance/check-in returns 200 + {ok:true, late, at}; missing selfie returns 400. (8) Manager RBAC: can access /console/sessions-caisse, /console/produits, /console/pos (200). Cannot access /console/finances, /console/parametres, /console/equipe, /console/livreur-app — all 4 redirect to /console (gated frontend-side). pytest 4/6 pass; 2 failures are intentional expectations about BACKEND endpoints /api/team and /api/users which are STILL open to manager (frontend gating only).

minor.issue: Manager receives 200 on these endpoints (frontend-only RBAC). If duty segregation is a hard requirement, enforce require_role('admin') server-side; otherwise a Gérante with API access could still list/modify users.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by dev-tooling wrapper injecting x-component <span> inside <option> in PeriodSelector.jsx line 96. Non-blocking but pollutes the console.

action_items: (optional) Decide whether /api/team and /api/users should be admin-only server-side to match the frontend RBAC. Today a manager JWT can hit them.
(optional) Fix PeriodSelector option children — only text, no <span>, to silence React hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx openCamera catch sets punchOnLogin=false silently — good UX fallback. But if the browser silently returns a stream and the user never clicks shoot, the submit still posts no attendance. That's correct (photoDataUrl guard) but worth documenting.

rbac.js: PATH_ROLES uses an empty array [] for admin-only paths, relying on canAccess() short-circuit (role==='admin' returns true). Clean and correct, but a comment on the empty-array convention would help future contributors.
attendance.py check-in: no size validation on the selfie base64 — a malicious client could POST a 50MB payload. Consider len(selfie) < ~2MB check.

CashSessions.jsx cash-no-session block duplicates the main 'Ouvrir ma journée' CTA that's already in the header. UX-wise this is intentional (visibility), but keep in mind both buttons dispatch the same setOpening(true) — any future change must update both.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright uses --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream + --use-fake-device-for-media-stream by default here, so getUserMedia works and the camera modal captures a real (black) frame. The admin's current cash session is in 'pending_validation' state, so cash-no-session block won't render for admin until that session is closed/validated. To test cash-no-session empty-state live: validate the pending handover first (cash-validate-handover) or seed with no session. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter57.py has 2 asserted failures for /api/team and /api/users (manager still gets 200) — change to assert 200 if the product decision is 'frontend gating is enough'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The only observations are: (a) frontend-only RBAC on team/users endpoints — valid product decision but worth flagging; (b) React hydration warning from dev-tool x-component wrapper (not functional).
